settings.heading: Named for an era.
settings.text: Daur means an era in Urdu. Ours is Aik naya daur, a new era.

settings.title: Who we are
settings.body: DAUR Supply is a Pakistani footwear brand for men, sold online at daursupply.com.

settings.title: What we sell
settings.body: Leather sneakers, formal shoes, chelsea boots and casual slip ons, crafted in Pakistan.

settings.title: How DAUR works
settings.body:
• We choose finished pairs from workshops in Lahore, Sialkot and Kasur and check every one by hand.
  • Every order is confirmed with you by call or WhatsApp, then leaves Islamabad within 24 hours of confirmation.
  • A small Care deposit by bank transfer, the rest on delivery, and free delivery on every order.
  • Size exchange within 5 days, defects covered for 30 days.

settings.title: Our identity
settings.body:
Thick matte black cotton laces, an engraved metal lace tag and the DAUR seal: that is how you know a pair is ours. The leather does the rest.

Same local craft. Zero retail markup. Aik naya daur. A new era.

settings.title: Contact
settings.body: WhatsApp or call 0319 9628735, or email contact@daursupply.com. Every order is confirmed with you before it ships.
